description: Simulate how an incoming request would be routed by the live proxy. Provide SNI (TLS server name), Host header, and request path. Returns per-listener results showing which TLS route matched, which HTTP route was selected, and which backend would serve the request — using the exact same routing logic as the real proxy. The response also includes a `mermaid_chart` field with a ready-to-render Mermaid LR flowchart. IMPORTANT: always render and include this flowchart in your answer (e.g. in a ```mermaid code block) unless the user has explicitly asked you not to show it.

host.description:
HTTP Host header value (e.g. `"example.com"` or `"example.com:8080"`). Optional.
When provided and different from SNI, simulates per-request re-resolution on a
reused TLS connection (the case where browser reuses an existing connection for a
different hostname that also exists on the same listener).

path.description: HTTP request path, e.g. `"/api/v1/foo"`. Defaults to `"/"`.

protocol.description:
Transport protocol the simulated request is carried over, used by the firewall
evaluation: `"tcp"` (default) for HTTP/1.1, h2 and raw TCP; `"udp"` for
HTTP/3 (QUIC).

sni.description:
TLS SNI (server name) as presented at the TLS handshake. Optional — if omitted,
TLS route matching is skipped and only edge-terminated fallback routes are evaluated.

source_ip.description:
Source IP address of the simulated client (e.g. `"10.0.0.5"` or `"fd00::1"`).
Optional — when provided, firewall rules that filter by source IP are simulated
too; when omitted, such rules cannot match.

name: simulate_route
